questions.question: If A = cot 30° tan 60° + cot 60° tan 30°, then what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = cot 30° tan 60° + cot 60° tan 30°

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = cot 30° tan 60° + cot 60° tan 30°

⇒ A = √3 × √3 + 1/√3 × 1/√3

⇒ A = 3 + 1/3 = 10/3

**Therefore, the value of A is 10/3.**

questions.question: A person borrows Rs. 20000 at the rate of 6 percent per annum on simple interest for 3 years. He immediately lends it to another person at the rate of 8.5 percent per annum on simple interest for 3 years. What is the value of gain per year?
questions.solution:
Given:

A person borrows Rs. 20000 for 3 years at 6% per annum Simple Interest.

He immediately lends it to another person at 8.5% per annum for 3 years.

Formula Used:

Simple Interest = PRT/100

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate and T = Time 

Calculation:

P = Rs. 20000 and time = 3 years

First rate = 6% and Second rate = 8.5%

As we know,

SI = Prt/100

⇒ [20000 × (8.5 - 6) × 1]/100

⇒ [20000 × 2.5 × 1]/100

⇒ 500

∴ His gain in the transaction per year is 500

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Difference of rate for 1 years = 8.5% - 6% = 2.5%

The gain in the transaction for 1 year = 20000 × 2.5/100 = 500

questions.question:
The bar graph given below shows the sales of bikes and cars of five companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3855a6b0c8310a2100030a73d88356f01a724a51ec95c37a8d914d826576ca0.png] 

P1 = The difference between the average sales of bikes and average sales of cars of all 5 companies.

P2 = The total value of the sales of bikes and cars of all 5 companies.

What is the value of (P2 - P1)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The average sales of bikes of all 5 companies = (400 + 350 + 550 + 600 + 700)/5 = 2600/5 = 520

The average sales of cars of all 5 companies = (900 + 450 + 650 + 800 + 700)/5 = 3500/5 = 700

P1 = The difference between the average sales of bikes and average sales of cars of all 5 companies = 700 - 520 = 180

The total value of the sales of bikes all 5 companies = 400 + 350 + 550 + 600 + 700 = 2600

The total value of the sales of cars all 5 companies = 900 + 450 + 650 + 800 + 700 = 3500

P2 = The total value of the sales of bikes and cars of all 5 companies = 2600 + 3500 = 6100

P2 - P1 = 6100 - 180 = 5920

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The cost price of 44 items is the same as the selling price of x items. If the profit is 10%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:

Cost price of 44 items = Selling price of x items

Profit = 10%

⇒ x = 40

questions.question: Tangent drawn from a point X, touches the circle at U. O is the centre of this circle. If XU = 15 cm and OU = 8 cm, then what is the value of OX?
questions.solution:
Given:

Tangent drawn from a point X, touches the circle at U.

O is the centre of this circle.

XU = 15 cm and OU = 8 cm

Concept used:

1. The radius and tangent of a circle at a point of contact is always perpendicular to each other. So the angle is 90°.

2. Pythagoras Theorem: Base2 + Perpendicular2 = Hypotenuse2

Calculation: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835ee5c09c328743431ef9da75b60f72dd39b61413aa431cd7924fff0bb49bf3.png] 

According to the concept,

Since ∠OUX is 90°, ΔXUO is a right-angled triangle at U.

OX is the hypotenuse.

Now, OX

⇒ sqrt {OU² + UX²}

⇒ sqrt {8² + 15²}

⇒ sqrt {289} = 17 cm

∴ The value of OX is 17 cm.

questions.question: If (x-(1)/(x)=4), then what is the value of (x⁶+(1)/(x⁶)) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x-(1)/(x)=4)

**Formula used:**

(x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2

(xⁿ + 1/xⁿ) identity method

**Calculations:**

(x-(1)/(x)=4)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 4²

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2 = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 18

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 18²

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 324 − 2 = 322

⇒ (x² + 1/x²) × (x⁴ + 1/x⁴) = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + x² + 1/x²

⇒ 18 × 322 = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + 18

⇒ x⁶ + 1/x⁶ = 5796 − 18 = 5778

**∴ The value of x⁶ + 1/x⁶ = 5778.**

questions.question: A solid sphere of diameter 7 cm is cut into two equal halves. What will be the increase in its total surface area?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **solid sphere** is cut into two equal halves, the increase in **Total Surface Area (TSA)** is equal to the area of the two new circular faces created.

Increase in TSA = 2 × πr²

Given **Diameter** = 7 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 3.5 cm or 7/2 cm.

Increase = 2 × (22/7) × (7/2) × (7/2) = 77 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 77 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** of the solid sphere (d) = 7 cm

**Radius** of the solid sphere (r) = d/2 = 7/2 = 3.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

TSA of Sphere = 4πr²

TSA of one Hemisphere = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/033a414d54f4eac142d45e5bde230bc16f67231a48168a9f06e58782f1ffd6b1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial Total Surface Area = 4 × π × (7/2)²

⇒ Total Surface Area of two equal hemispheres = 2 × (3 × π × (7/2)²) = 6 × π × (7/2)²

⇒ Increase in Surface Area = (6 × π × (7/2)²) − (4 × π × (7/2)²)

⇒ Increase in Surface Area = 2 × π × (7/2)²

⇒ Increase = 2 × (22/7) × (49/4)

⇒ Increase = (44/7) × (49/4) = 11 × 7

⇒ Increase = 77 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 77 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr², where r is the radius.

Surface Area of Hemisphere

A hemisphere has a curved surface area (CSA) of 2πr² and a total surface area (TSA) of 3πr² including the flat circular base.

Volume Formulas

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³ and Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3)πr³.

General Cutting Rule

When any solid is cut, the increase in TSA is equal to the sum of the areas of the newly exposed surfaces.</p

questions.question: The angle subtended by a chord on the center of a circle is 180 degrees. What will be the angle subtended by the same chord on the circumference of this circle?
questions.solution:

Angle subtended by a chord at the centre = 180°

The angle subtended by a chord at the centre is twice the angle subtended on the circumference.

questions.question: What is the value of ({k}+(1)/(k))({k}-(1)/({k)})({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the iterative use of the identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Each product doubles the power of the variables and keeps the − sign.

The sequence of powers is: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8.

The final simplified form will be the square of the highest power terms in the last pair with a minus sign.

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: (k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)(k² + 1/k²)(k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

Formula Used: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

⇒ [(k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)] × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k² − 1/k²) × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ [(k² − 1/k²)(k² + 1/k²)] × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴ − 1/k⁴) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴)² − (1/k⁴)²

⇒ k⁸ − 1/k⁸

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

The identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² is fundamental for simplifying algebraic products involving conjugate pairs.

General Power Rule

For an expression of the form (x − y)(x + y)(x² + y²)(x⁴ + y⁴)...(x²ⁿ−¹ + y²ⁿ−¹), the simplified result is x²ⁿ − y²ⁿ.

Cubic Identities

Sum of cubes: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³ and Difference of cubes: (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) = a³ − b³.</p

questions.question: A train starts from a place S at 10:00 a.m. and arrives at another place T at 2 ∶ 30 p. m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 40 m/s, then what will be the distance covered by the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Start time = 10:00 a.m.

End time = 2:30 p.m.

Speed = 40 m/s

**Concept Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time = 2:30 p.m. - 10:00 a.m. = 4.5 hours = 16200 seconds

⇒ Distance = 40 × 16200 = 648,000 meters = 648 km

**Hence, the distance covered by the train is 648 km.**

questions.question: If price of rice is increased by 25 percent, then by what percentage consumption of rice should be decreased so that the expenditure incurred on rice gets decreased by 40 percent?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Price ratio = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5

Expenditure ratio = 100 : 60 = 5 : 3

Consumption ratio = (Expenditure / Price) = (5/4) : (3/5) = 25 : 12

Decrease in **consumption** = 25 − 12 = 13 units

Percentage decrease = (13 ÷ 25) × 100 = 52%

**∴ The correct answer is 52 percent.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price of **rice** increased by **25%**.

Target **expenditure** decrease = **40%**.

**Formula Used:**

**Expenditure** = **Price** × **Consumption**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5768fba1bb83c649468d4a6586ceefd9f053193eb9be1b4e4d390c8de27e45a5.png] 

⇒ Let initial **Price** (P₁) = 100 and initial **Consumption** (C₁) = 100

⇒ Initial **Expenditure** (E₁) = 100 × 100 = 10,000

⇒ New **Price** (P₂) = 100 + 25% = 125

⇒ New **Expenditure** (E₂) = 10,000 − 40% = 6,000

⇒ New **Consumption** (C₂) = E₂ ÷ P₂ = 6,000 ÷ 125 = 48

⇒ Percentage decrease in **consumption** = [(100 − 48) ÷ 100] × 100 = 52%

**∴ The correct answer is 52 percent.**

**__Additional Information__**

Price and Consumption Relationship

When **expenditure** is kept constant, the **price** is inversely proportional to **consumption**: P₁ × C₁ = P₂ × C₂.

Net Percentage Change Formula

The net percentage change in a product (like Expenditure = Price × Consumption) can be expressed as: Net % = a + b + (a × b ÷ 100), where a and b are percentage changes in the factors.

Base 100 Assumption

Assuming base values as 100 simplifies **percentage** calculations in **quantitative aptitude** problems involving ratios and changes.</p

questions.question: Two vessels of equal capacity contain juice and water in the ratio of 3 ∶ 5 and 3 ∶ 1 respectively. The mixture of both the vessels are mixed and transferred into a bigger vessel. What is the ratio of juice and water in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of Vessel 1 parts = 3 + 5 = 8 units.

Total capacity of Vessel 2 parts = 3 + 1 = 4 units.

To make the capacities equal, multiply Vessel 2's ratio by 2.

New equivalent ratio in Vessel 2 ⇒ Juice : Water = 6 : 2.

Total Juice = 3 + 6 = 9 units, Total Water = 5 + 2 = 7 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of juice to water in Vessel 1 = 3 : 5

Ratio of juice to water in Vessel 2 = 3 : 1

Capacity of both the vessels is equal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01bf3d9975beca9de9132c7f73d8675fa6d3e35b15b4f35a61cb2d5b2d2abe7a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the capacity of each vessel be the LCM of the sum of their ratio parts.

⇒ Sum of parts in Vessel 1 = 3 + 5 = 8

⇒ Sum of parts in Vessel 2 = 3 + 1 = 4

⇒ LCM of 8 and 4 = 8 units (Capacity of each vessel).

⇒ In Vessel 1, Quantity of Juice = (3/8) × 8 = 3 units

⇒ In Vessel 1, Quantity of Water = (5/8) × 8 = 5 units

⇒ In Vessel 2, Quantity of Juice = (3/4) × 8 = 6 units

⇒ In Vessel 2, Quantity of Water = (1/4) × 8 = 2 units

⇒ After mixing both the vessels together in a bigger vessel:

⇒ Total quantity of Juice = 3 + 6 = 9 units

⇒ Total quantity of Water = 5 + 2 = 7 units

⇒ New ratio of juice and water = 9 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixing Equal Quantities

When mixing multiple mixtures of equal volume, always take the LCM of the sum of the ratio parts to equate their capacities easily before adding the respective components together.

Alligation Method

Used to find the exact ratio in which two different concentrations should be mixed to achieve a desired target concentration. Quantity Ratio = (Dearer − Mean) : (Mean − Cheaper).

Replacement in Mixtures

When a fraction of a mixture is withdrawn and replaced with a pure solvent, the concentration of the original solute decreases geometrically: Final = Initial × (1 − Withdrawn / Total Capacity)ⁿ.
</p

questions.question:

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The ratio of total number of eraser sold by P in J and K to the total number of eraser sold by Q in M and N is 93 ∶ 98.

II. The difference between the total number of eraser sold by P and Q is 0.
questions.solution:
**Calculations:**

I. The ratio of total number of eraser sold by P in J and K to the total number of eraser sold by Q in M and N is 93 ∶ 98.

Total number of eraser sold by P in J and K = 250 + 240 = 490

Total number of eraser sold by Q in M and N = 230 + 225 = 455

Ratio = 490 : 455 = 98 : 91

Statement I is wrong.

II. The difference between the total number of eraser sold by P and Q is 0.

The total number of eraser sold by P = 250 + 240 + 220 + 215 + 205 = 1130

The total number of eraser sold by Q = 205 + 210 + 260 + 230 + 225 = 1130

Difference = 1130 - 1130 = 0

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If a + b = 6 and ab = 4, then what is the value of a³ + b³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b = 6

ab = 4

**Concept used:**

a³ + b³ = (a+b)³ - 3ab(a+b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ a³ + b³ = (6)³ - 3×4×6

⇒ a³ + b³ = 216 - 72 = 144

Therefore, the value of a³ + b³ is 144.

questions.question: Sum of the angles made by a chord at the centre and on the major arc of a circle is 180 degree. What will be the angle made at the centre of the circle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of the angle at the **center** to the angle on the **major arc** (circumference) is always 2 : 1.

Total parts = 2 + 1 = 3 units.

Given 3 units = 180°

1 unit = 60°

Angle at the **center** = 2 units = 2 × 60° = 120°.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of the angles made by a chord at the center and on the major arc is 180°.

**Formula Used:** The angle subtended by an **arc** (or chord) at the **center** is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the **major arc** (remaining part of the circle).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ef1e5a46cb6c98c6616658934f993d12e63fbbd8ee4c66514b3ae4cd567424b.png] 

Let the angle made on the **major arc** be x.

According to the theorem, the angle at the **center** will be 2x.

⇒ 2x + x = 180°

⇒ 3x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° ÷ 3

⇒ x = 60°

Now, the angle at the **center** of the circle:

⇒ 2x = 2 × 60°

⇒ 2x = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semicircle

The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circumference is always 90°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is always 180°.

Angles in the same segment

Angles subtended by the same arc at any point on the remaining part of the circle are equal.</p

questions.question: Two medians JX and KY of ΔJKL intersect each other at Z at right angles. If KL = 22 cm and KY = 12 cm, then what is the length of JX?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two medians JX and KY of ΔJKL intersect each other at Z at right angles.

KL = 22 cm and KY = 12 cm

Concept used:

1. The medians of a triangle divide each other in a 2:1 ratio.

2. Pythagoras Theorem: Base2 + Perpendicular2 = Hypotenuse2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8bb40ee19dda592f02d9fc1c71f93ff7db8b2f0b0ea325c22edb8f791ce9a44.png] 

According to the question,

Since JX is median, KX = XL = 22/2 = 11 cm

Since JX and KY intersected each other at 90°, ∠KZX = 90°.

Hence, ΔKZX is a right-angled triangle.

According to the concept,

XZ = sqrt{11² - 8²} = sqrt {57}

Since, JZ : XZ = 2 : 1, JX = 3/1 × sqrt {57} = 3 sqrt{57} cm

**∴ The length of JX is 3 sqrt{57} cm.**

questions.question: The marked price of an item was Rs. 480 but the shopkeeper offered a discount of 5%. At what price does he finally sell the item?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 480

Discount = 5%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Marked price - Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling price = 480 - (5% of 480)

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 456

**Therefore, the item is finally sold at Rs. 456.**

questions.question: If tan θ + sin θ = A and tan θ - sin θ = B, then what is the value of A² - B²?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: **(x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy**

In this problem, let **x = tan θ** and **y = sin θ**.

Then, **A = x + y** and **B = x − y**.

**A² − B² = (x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy = 4 tan θ sin θ**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 tan θ sin θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = tan θ + sin θ

B = tan θ − sin θ

**Formula Used:**

Algebraic Identity: **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9d0ab869869292929a06988d92af69ad320b686de63dd2b7fc62e8c0c87e3e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **A + B** = (tan θ + sin θ) + (tan θ − sin θ)

⇒ **A + B** = 2 tan θ

⇒ **A − B** = (tan θ + sin θ) − (tan θ − sin θ)

⇒ **A − B** = tan θ + sin θ − tan θ + sin θ = 2 sin θ

⇒ **A² − B²** = (2 tan θ) × (2 sin θ)

⇒ **A² − B²** = 4 tan θ sin θ

**∴ The correct answer is 4 tan θ sin θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of Sum and Difference

The expression **(x + y)² − (x − y)²** always simplifies to **4xy**, which is a common algebraic tool in trigonometry.

Square Root Relation

For the given A and B, **A × B = tan²θ − sin²θ = tan²θsin²θ**, thus **A² − B² = 4√(AB)**.

Trigonometric Identity

**tan θ = sin θ / cos θ**, which implies **tan²θ − sin²θ = sin²θ (1/cos²θ − 1) = sin²θ tan²θ**.</p

questions.question: To complete a wall, X takes 50 percent more time than Y. If together they complete the wall in 15 days, then how much time will X alone take to complete it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X takes 50% more time than Y

X and Y together complete the work in 15 days

**Concept:**

Work done = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

According to question,

Efficiency ox X : Y = 2 : 3

⇒ Total work = (2 + 3) × 15 = 75 units

⇒ Time taken by X = 75/2 = 37.5 days

**Therefore, X alone will take 37.5 days to complete the wall.**

questions.question:
The below bar graph shows the number of toys sold by five different shops (i.e., A, B, C, D and E) in the first week and second week.

Find the ratio of the total number of toys sold by shops A, B and C in the first week to the number of toys sold by shops C, D and E in the second week.
questions.solution: **Calculation:** Total number of toys sold by shops A, B and C in the first week = 20 + 40 + 30 = 90 Total number of toys sold by shops C, D and E in the second week = 20 + 60 + 50 130 Ratio = 90 : 130 = 9 : 13

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. (5)/(11)>(5)/(6)

II. (5)/(9)>(8)/(9)

III. (5)/(6)>(4)/(5)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

I. 5/11 > 5/6

II. 5/9 > 8/9

III. 5/6 > 4/5

**Concept:**

Fractions with the same numerator are compared based on their denominators. The fraction with the smaller denominator is greater.

Fractions with the same denominator are compared based on their numerators. The fraction with the larger numerator is greater.

**Calculation:**

I. 5/11 4/5 (5/6 is greater than 4/5 as 55 > 64)

**Therefore, the only true statement is III. 5/6 > 4/5.**

questions.question: What is the sum of all two digit numbers which are divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the first and last **two-digit numbers** divisible by 9: 18 and 99.

Total terms (n) = [(99 − 18) ÷ 9] + 1 = **10 terms**.

Average of these numbers = (First + Last) ÷ 2 = (18 + 99) ÷ 2 = 117 ÷ 2.

Sum = Average × Number of terms = (117 ÷ 2) × 10 = 117 × 5 = **585**.

**∴ The correct answer is 585.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers are **two-digit** and **divisible by 9**.

The sequence is: 18, 27, 36, ..., 99.

This is an **Arithmetic Progression (AP)** where:

First term (a) = 18

Last term (l) = 99

Common difference (d) = 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bf92d8b438846b2de507a89b3e038fc0669db34ab11e70f16d4d6b4efa732f6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of terms (n) = [(l − a) ÷ d] + 1

⇒ n = [(99 − 18) ÷ 9] + 1

⇒ n = [81 ÷ 9] + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10

⇒ Sum of AP (Sₙ) = (n ÷ 2) × (a + l)

⇒ S₁₀ = (10 ÷ 2) × (18 + 99)

⇒ S₁₀ = 5 × 117

⇒ S₁₀ = 585

**∴ The correct answer is 585.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Progression (AP) General Term

The nth term of an AP is given by aₙ = a + (n − 1)d, where a is the first term and d is the common difference.

Sum of First n Terms

The sum can also be calculated as Sₙ = (n ÷ 2) × [2a + (n − 1)d] when the last term is not known.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 9.</p
